Subterranean Home Built During the Cold War (volume is a bit high)

More pictures in this article.

 

Jerry Hendersen is best known as a director of Avon Products, but in 1964 he formed the company "Underground World Homes", and he sponsored the Underground Home exhibit at the New York Worlds Fair.

 

The house in the video is a nifty time capsule of the 1970's, with 2 bedrooms and another in the guest house. And, of course, there's the 2 bedroom, two storey house above the ground as well...

 

The underground garden has a putting green, dance floor, bar, swimming pool, jacuzzis - combined with the murals and lighting effects (including twinkling stars) helping distract you, from well, Armageddon above ground...

I've long been intrigued by this house because, the dubious aesthetics aside, it hints at the possibilities of Lunar and Mars habitats which will likely be similarly fashioned by excavation or similarly-shaped built-up windowless shells. I look at this and imagine what would be possible with today's indoor farming techniques and current synthetic sky and video window-wall technology. Places like the Kansas City Subtropolis offer a good analog to early excavated habitats and I think it would be fun and educational to use it to host a home and garden show of space where people can explore the possibilities of living well indoors and underground.

November 5

19 Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus, 20 By a new and living way, which he hath consecrated for us, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh; 21 And having an high priest over the house of God; - Heb 10:19-21 (KJV)

 When Jesus died on the cross, the veil of the Temple was split into from top to bottom (Matthew 27:51), and that signified that the holiest portion of the Temple was now open for us, who are born again, to enter into the very presence of God. This boldness that we now enjoy, to appear before the Father, was because of the blood of Jesus being spilt for us, purifying us before the Father. This is why Jesus said that He was the only way to the Father (John 14:6), as there is no other way.

 Jesus flesh was representative of the veil of the Temple, and when His flesh was rent, the veil did also, and by giving His life for us, He made a new and living way for us to be able to fellowship with the Father. This was what eternal life was all about (John 17:3), and is why Jesus had to come and spill His blood for us (John 3:16), so the Father could again fellowship with His creation. It was all about the Father wanting to fellowship with us, and not about us.

 Jesus is now our high priest (Hebrews 3:1), after the order of Melchisedec (Hebrews 5:10), in the house of God, and we are the house of Jesus (Hebrews 3:6), and this gives us His righteousness which allows us to appear before the Father. What a wonderful blessing it is, to know that we can appear directly before the Father with our praise, needs, and thanks, in prayer. Praise God for Jesus, and all the blessings He brought to us who believe in Him.
